# Analysis settings
# KPMP assignment table contains 2 metabotypes
```{r settings}
# The saved KPMP assignment table is expected to contain two metabotypes.
expected_kpmp_k        <- 2L
validation_k           <- 2L
nstart_kmeans          <- 50L
clustering_seed        <- 123L
expected_shared_count  <- 634L
enforce_shared_count   <- FALSE

# Elastic-net settings.
elastic_net_alpha      <- 0.5
outer_cv_folds         <- 5L
inner_cv_folds         <- 10L
classifier_seed        <- 20261011L

# The binary target is 1 for KPMP Metabotype 1 (the lower-eGFR metabotype).
# The classification threshold is selected from KPMP out-of-fold predictions
# by Youden's J and is then held fixed for validation.
positive_metabotype    <- 1L

metabotype_colors <- c("1" = "#1b9e77", "2" = "#7570b3")
group_colors <- c(
  "CKD" = "#fc8d62",
  "Healthy Reference" = "#66c2a5"
)
```

```{r helper-functions}
clean_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "`", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^g(?=[0-9]{1,3}-[0-9]{4,6}$)", "")
  x
}

find_first_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}

extract_bracket_id <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_match(as.character(x), "\\[([0-9]+)\\]$")[, 2]
}

extract_validation_name <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_trim(
    stringr::str_remove(as.character(x), "\\s*\\[[0-9]+\\]$")
  )
}

save_tiff <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
}

save_pdf <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )
}

# This is the original cohort-level preprocessing used before k-means:
# optional log2(x + 1), means and SDs estimated before imputation, mean
# imputation, and z-scoring.
preprocess_clustering_matrix <- function(X_raw) {
  X_raw <- as.matrix(X_raw)
  storage.mode(X_raw) <- "numeric"

  use_log2 <- all(X_raw >= 0 | is.na(X_raw))
  X_work <- if (use_log2) log2(X_raw + 1) else X_raw

  means <- colMeans(X_work, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds <- apply(X_work, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  means[!is.finite(means)] <- 0
  sds[!is.finite(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_work))) {
    missing_j <- is.na(X_work[, j])
    if (any(missing_j)) X_work[missing_j, j] <- means[j]
  }

  list(
    X = scale(X_work, center = means, scale = sds),
    means = means,
    sds = sds,
    use_log2 = use_log2
  )
}

# Fit a preprocessing recipe in discovery data. This recipe is part of the
# classifier and is saved with the final model.
fit_discovery_preprocessor <- function(X_raw) {
  X_raw <- as.matrix(X_raw)
  storage.mode(X_raw) <- "numeric"
  X_raw[!is.finite(X_raw)] <- NA_real_

  use_log2 <- all(X_raw >= 0 | is.na(X_raw))
  X_work <- if (use_log2) log2(X_raw + 1) else X_raw

  means <- colMeans(X_work, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds <- apply(X_work, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  means[!is.finite(means)] <- 0
  sds[!is.finite(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_work))) {
    missing_j <- is.na(X_work[, j])
    if (any(missing_j)) X_work[missing_j, j] <- means[j]
  }

  list(
    X = scale(X_work, center = means, scale = sds),
    recipe = list(
      feature_names = colnames(X_raw),
      use_log2 = use_log2,
      means = means,
      sds = sds
    )
  )
}

# Apply the KPMP-fitted recipe to new participants. No validation mean, SD,
# imputation value, outcome, or cluster assignment is used here.
apply_discovery_preprocessor <- function(X_raw, recipe) {
  X_raw <- as.matrix(X_raw)
  storage.mode(X_raw) <- "numeric"

  missing_features <- setdiff(recipe$feature_names, colnames(X_raw))
  if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
    stop(
      "New data are missing classifier feature(s): ",
      paste(missing_features, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  X_raw <- X_raw[, recipe$feature_names, drop = FALSE]
  X_raw[!is.finite(X_raw)] <- NA_real_

  if (recipe$use_log2) {
    if (any(X_raw < -1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      stop("Negative validation values below -1 cannot receive log2(x + 1).")
    }
    X_raw <- log2(X_raw + 1)
  }

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_raw))) {
    missing_j <- is.na(X_raw[, j])
    if (any(missing_j)) X_raw[missing_j, j] <- recipe$means[j]
  }

  scale(X_raw, center = recipe$means, scale = recipe$sds)
}

make_stratified_folds <- function(y, k, seed) {
  y <- as.integer(y)
  class_counts <- table(y)
  k <- min(as.integer(k), min(class_counts))
  if (k < 3L) stop("At least three observations per class are required.")

  fold_id <- integer(length(y))
  classes <- sort(unique(y))

  for (i in seq_along(classes)) {
    class_index <- which(y == classes[i])
    set.seed(seed + i)
    class_index <- sample(class_index)
    fold_id[class_index] <- rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(class_index))
  }

  fold_id
}

extract_coefficients <- function(cv_fit, s = "lambda.1se") {
  coefficient_matrix <- as.matrix(stats::coef(cv_fit, s = s))
  tibble(
    metabolite = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
    coefficient = as.numeric(coefficient_matrix[, 1]),
    lambda = s
  ) %>%
    filter(metabolite != "(Intercept)") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(coefficient)))
}

roc_to_df <- function(roc_object, curve_name) {
  tibble(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - roc_object$specificities,
    true_positive_rate = roc_object$sensitivities,
    curve = curve_name
  ) %>%
    arrange(false_positive_rate, true_positive_rate)
}

safe_profile_contrast <- function(X, group_one) {
  group_one <- as.logical(group_one)
  if (sum(group_one) == 0 || sum(!group_one) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(X)))
  }
  colMeans(X[group_one, , drop = FALSE]) -
    colMeans(X[!group_one, , drop = FALSE])
}

safe_fisher_test <- function(count_table) {
  tryCatch(
    stats::fisher.test(count_table),
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        estimate = NA_real_,
        conf.int = c(NA_real_, NA_real_),
        p.value = NA_real_
      )
    }
  )
}

# Convert the known validation enrollment labels to a binary CKD indicator.
# Unrecognized labels are retained as NA and omitted only from CKD evaluations.
make_ckd_indicator <- function(group) {
  normalized <- stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_squish(as.character(group)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    normalized %in% c("ckd", "chronic kidney disease") ~ 1L,
    stringr::str_detect(normalized, "healthy|reference|control") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}
```

# Prepare the KPMP discovery cohort

```{r prepare-kpmp}
prepare_kpmp <- function(plasma_raw, clinical_raw) {
  plasma_raw <- plasma_raw %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  participant_col <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("participant_id", "participant", "participantid")
  )
  metabolite_col <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("metabolite", "metabolite_id")
  )
  abundance_col <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("abundance", "value", "intensity", "peak_area")
  )
  name_col <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("chemical_name", "chemical_name_", "chem_name", "biochemical")
  )

  if (any(is.na(c(participant_col, metabolite_col, abundance_col)))) {
    stop("Could not detect the required columns in Plasma_Metabolomics.xlsx.")
  }

  plasma_long <- plasma_raw %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = clean_id(.data[[participant_col]]),
      metabolite = as.character(.data[[metabolite_col]]),
      metabolite_label = if (!is.na(name_col)) {
        as.character(.data[[name_col]])
      } else {
        as.character(.data[[metabolite_col]])
      },
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[abundance_col]]))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(participant_id), !is.na(metabolite), !is.na(abundance))

  labels <- plasma_long %>%
    distinct(metabolite, metabolite_label)

  wide <- plasma_long %>%
    group_by(participant_id, metabolite) %>%
    summarize(abundance = median(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = abundance)

  missingness <- wide %>%
    summarize(across(-participant_id, ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "metabolite",
      values_to = "missing_rate"
    )

  # Metabolite IDs before the missingness filter (used for the shared-count audit).
  all_metabolites <- setdiff(names(wide), "participant_id")

  retained_metabolites <- missingness %>%
    filter(missing_rate <= 0.70) %>%
    pull(metabolite)

  wide <- wide %>%
    select(participant_id, all_of(retained_metabolites))

  clinical_raw <- clinical_raw %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  clinical_participant_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("participant_id", "participant", "participantid")
  )
  sample_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("sample_id", "sampleid", "specimen_id")
  )
  group_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("group", "enrollment_category", "disease_group")
  )
  egfr_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c(
      "baseline_e_gfr_ml_min_1_73m2", "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73m2",
      "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73_m2", "egfrcr_cys", "egfr"
    )
  )

  if (any(is.na(c(clinical_participant_col, group_col, egfr_col)))) {
    stop("Could not detect participant ID, group, or eGFR in the KPMP clinical file.")
  }

  clinical <- clinical_raw %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = clean_id(.data[[clinical_participant_col]]),
      sample_id = if (!is.na(sample_col)) {
        clean_id(.data[[sample_col]])
      } else {
        participant_id
      },
      group = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      egfr = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[egfr_col]]))
    ) %>%
    distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  analysis_df <- wide %>%
    inner_join(clinical, by = "participant_id")

  meta <- analysis_df %>%
    select(participant_id, sample_id, group, egfr)

  X_raw <- analysis_df %>%
    select(all_of(retained_metabolites)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  rownames(X_raw) <- meta$participant_id

  list(
    meta = meta,
    X_raw = X_raw,
    labels = labels,
    missingness = missingness,
    all_metabolites = all_metabolites
  )
}

kpmp <- prepare_kpmp(kpmp_plasma_raw, kpmp_clinical_raw)

cat(
  "KPMP matrix:", nrow(kpmp$X_raw), "participants x",
  ncol(kpmp$X_raw), "metabolites\n"
)
```



```{r prepare-validation}

prepare_validation <- function(combined_raw) {
  clean_names <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(combined_raw))

  original_name <- function(clean_name) {
    hit <- which(clean_names == clean_name)
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(combined_raw)[hit[1]]
  }

  sample_col <- original_name("sample_id")
  cohort_col <- original_name("cohort")
  group_col <- original_name("group")

  if (any(is.na(c(sample_col, cohort_col, group_col)))) {
    stop(
      "The Combined sheet of Validation_cleaned.xlsx must contain ",
      "sample_id, cohort, and group columns."
    )
  }

  meta <- combined_raw %>%
    transmute(
      sample_id = clean_id(.data[[sample_col]]),
      cohort = as.character(.data[[cohort_col]]),
      group = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      ckd_status = make_ckd_indicator(.data[[group_col]])
    )

  feature_df <- combined_raw %>%
    select(-all_of(c(sample_col, cohort_col, group_col)))

  feature_names <- names(feature_df)
  metabolite_ids <- extract_bracket_id(feature_names)
  metabolite_names <- extract_validation_name(feature_names)

  keep_feature <- !is.na(metabolite_ids)
  feature_df <- feature_df[, keep_feature, drop = FALSE] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))
  metabolite_ids <- metabolite_ids[keep_feature]
  metabolite_names <- metabolite_names[keep_feature]

  X0 <- as.matrix(feature_df)
  unique_ids <- unique(metabolite_ids)

  X_list <- lapply(unique_ids, function(id) {
    index <- which(metabolite_ids == id)
    values <- X0[, index, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(values) == 1) {
      as.numeric(values[, 1])
    } else {
      apply(values, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  })

  X_raw <- do.call(cbind, X_list)
  if (is.vector(X_raw)) X_raw <- matrix(X_raw, ncol = 1)
  colnames(X_raw) <- unique_ids
  rownames(X_raw) <- meta$sample_id

  sd_value <- apply(X_raw, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  prevalence <- 100 * colSums(!is.na(X_raw) & X_raw != 0) / nrow(X_raw)
  retain <- is.finite(sd_value) & sd_value > 0 & prevalence >= 30
  X_raw <- X_raw[, retain, drop = FALSE]

  # Preserve the original validation preprocessing convention: values that
  # remain undetected after duplicate consolidation are represented as zero.
  X_raw[is.na(X_raw)] <- 0

  labels <- tibble(
    metabolite = unique_ids,
    validation_label = vapply(
      unique_ids,
      function(id) metabolite_names[match(id, metabolite_ids)][1],
      character(1)
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(metabolite %in% colnames(X_raw)) %>%
    distinct(metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE)

  list(meta = meta, X_raw = X_raw, labels = labels, all_ids = unique_ids)
}

validation <- prepare_validation(validation_combined_raw)

shared_metabolites <- intersect(
  colnames(kpmp$X_raw),
  colnames(validation$X_raw)
)

cat(
  "Validation matrix:", nrow(validation$X_raw), "participants x",
  ncol(validation$X_raw), "retained metabolites\n",
  "Shared KPMP-validation metabolites:", length(shared_metabolites), "\n"
)

if (length(shared_metabolites) != expected_shared_count) {
  count_message <- paste0(
    "Expected ", expected_shared_count, " shared metabolites but found ",
    length(shared_metabolites), ". Check the input versions and filtering."
  )
  if (enforce_shared_count) stop(count_message) else warning(count_message)
}

if (length(shared_metabolites) < 10) {
  stop("Fewer than 10 shared metabolites were identified.")
}
```

# Generate an independent validation k = 2 solution for comparison only

```{r independent-validation-k2}
validation_shared_raw <- validation$X_raw[, shared_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
validation_clustering_preprocessing <- preprocess_clustering_matrix(
  validation_shared_raw
)
validation_X_cluster <- validation_clustering_preprocessing$X
rownames(validation_X_cluster) <- validation$meta$sample_id

set.seed(clustering_seed)
validation_kmeans_k2 <- stats::kmeans(
  validation_X_cluster,
  centers = validation_k,
  nstart = nstart_kmeans,
  algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong"
)

validation_ckd_prevalence <- tapply(
  validation$meta$ckd_status,
  validation_kmeans_k2$cluster,
  mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
validation_label_order <- order(
  validation_ckd_prevalence,
  decreasing = TRUE,
  na.last = TRUE
)
validation_label_map <- setNames(
  seq_along(validation_label_order),
  validation_label_order
)
validation_independent_metabotype <- as.integer(
  validation_label_map[as.character(validation_kmeans_k2$cluster)]
)

validation_independent_assignments <- validation$meta %>%
  mutate(independent_validation_metabotype = validation_independent_metabotype)

readr::write_csv(
  validation_independent_assignments,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_validation_independent_k2_assignments.csv")
)
```


# Internal KPMP cross-validation of the complete classifier pipeline

```{r classifier-functions}
run_nested_oof_classifier <- function(
    X_raw,
    y,
    alpha = 0.5,
    outer_folds = 5,
    inner_folds = 10,
    seed = 1) {

  outer_fold_id <- make_stratified_folds(y, outer_folds, seed)
  oof_probability <- rep(NA_real_, length(y))
  fold_summary <- vector("list", max(outer_fold_id))

  for (fold in seq_len(max(outer_fold_id))) {
    training_index <- which(outer_fold_id != fold)
    test_index <- which(outer_fold_id == fold)

    fold_preprocessing <- fit_discovery_preprocessor(
      X_raw[training_index, , drop = FALSE]
    )
    X_training <- fold_preprocessing$X
    X_test <- apply_discovery_preprocessor(
      X_raw[test_index, , drop = FALSE],
      fold_preprocessing$recipe
    )

    y_training <- y[training_index]
    inner_fold_id <- make_stratified_folds(
      y_training,
      inner_folds,
      seed + 1000L + fold
    )

    fold_model <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
      x = X_training,
      y = y_training,
      family = "binomial",
      alpha = alpha,
      foldid = inner_fold_id,
      type.measure = "auc",
      standardize = FALSE
    )

    oof_probability[test_index] <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        fold_model,
        newx = X_test,
        s = "lambda.1se",
        type = "response"
      )
    )

    fold_roc <- pROC::roc(
      response = y[test_index],
      predictor = oof_probability[test_index],
      levels = c(0, 1),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    fold_summary[[fold]] <- tibble(
      fold = fold,
      n_training = length(training_index),
      n_test = length(test_index),
      auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(fold_roc)),
      lambda_1se = fold_model$lambda.1se
    )
  }

  oof_roc <- pROC::roc(
    response = y,
    predictor = oof_probability,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  threshold_result <- pROC::coords(
    oof_roc,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = "threshold",
    transpose = FALSE
  )
  fixed_threshold <- if (is.data.frame(threshold_result) || is.matrix(threshold_result)) {
    as.numeric(threshold_result[1, "threshold"])
  } else {
    as.numeric(threshold_result[1])
  }
  if (!is.finite(fixed_threshold) || fixed_threshold <= 0 || fixed_threshold >= 1) {
    warning("A finite KPMP Youden threshold was not available; using 0.5.")
    fixed_threshold <- 0.5
  }

  list(
    probability = oof_probability,
    roc = oof_roc,
    fixed_threshold = fixed_threshold,
    fold_id = outer_fold_id,
    fold_summary = bind_rows(fold_summary)
  )
}
```

```{r run-kpmp-oof-classifier}
kpmp_shared_raw <- kpmp$X_raw[, shared_metabolites, drop = FALSE]
classifier_y <- kpmp_assignments$classifier_outcome

kpmp_oof <- run_nested_oof_classifier(
  X_raw = kpmp_shared_raw,
  y = classifier_y,
  alpha = elastic_net_alpha,
  outer_folds = outer_cv_folds,
  inner_folds = inner_cv_folds,
  seed = classifier_seed
)

kpmp_oof_predictions <- kpmp_assignments %>%
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    group,
    egfr,
    metabotype,
    classifier_outcome,
    outer_fold = kpmp_oof$fold_id,
    probability_metabotype_1 = kpmp_oof$probability,
    predicted_metabotype = if_else(
      probability_metabotype_1 >= kpmp_oof$fixed_threshold,
      1L,
      2L
    )
  )

kpmp_oof_auc_ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(kpmp_oof$roc, method = "delong"))

readr::write_csv(
  kpmp_oof_predictions,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_KPMP_out_of_fold_metabotype_predictions.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  kpmp_oof$fold_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_KPMP_outer_fold_performance.csv")
)
```

# Fit the final KPMP model and freeze the complete pipeline

```{r fit-final-kpmp-model}
final_preprocessing <- fit_discovery_preprocessor(kpmp_shared_raw)
kpmp_X_classifier <- final_preprocessing$X

final_inner_fold_id <- make_stratified_folds(
  classifier_y,
  inner_cv_folds,
  classifier_seed + 5000L
)

set.seed(classifier_seed + 5000L)
final_kpmp_model <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  x = kpmp_X_classifier,
  y = classifier_y,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = elastic_net_alpha,
  foldid = final_inner_fold_id,
  type.measure = "auc",
  standardize = FALSE
)

final_coefficients <- extract_coefficients(
  final_kpmp_model,
  s = "lambda.1se"
) %>%
  left_join(kpmp$labels, by = "metabolite")

preprocessing_table <- tibble(
  metabolite = final_preprocessing$recipe$feature_names,
  kpmp_mean_after_optional_log = as.numeric(final_preprocessing$recipe$means),
  kpmp_sd_after_optional_log = as.numeric(final_preprocessing$recipe$sds),
  log2_x_plus_1 = final_preprocessing$recipe$use_log2
)

fixed_classifier <- list(
  model = final_kpmp_model,
  preprocessing = final_preprocessing$recipe,
  threshold = kpmp_oof$fixed_threshold,
  positive_metabotype = positive_metabotype,
  shared_metabolites = shared_metabolites,
  alpha = elastic_net_alpha,
  lambda = final_kpmp_model$lambda.1se
)

saveRDS(
  fixed_classifier,
  file.path(output_dir, "KPMP__fixed_metabotype_classifier.rds")
)
readr::write_csv(
  final_coefficients,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__KPMP_fixed_classifier_coefficients.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  preprocessing_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__KPMP_fixed_preprocessing_parameters.csv")
)
```

# External evaluation

## Agreement with the independent validation k = 2 solution

```{r validation-cluster-agreement}
agreement_table <- validation_predictions %>%
  count(
    KPMP_assigned_metabotype,
    independent_validation_metabotype,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    KPMP_assigned_metabotype = 1:2,
    independent_validation_metabotype = 1:2,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  )

validation_exact_agreement <- mean(
  validation_predictions$KPMP_assigned_metabotype ==
    validation_predictions$independent_validation_metabotype
)

# Cohen's kappa corrects exact agreement for the agreement expected by chance
# given the two label distributions (the Fisher p-value is not informative here).
cohen_kappa <- function(x, y, levels = 1:2) {
  tab <- table(factor(x, levels = levels), factor(y, levels = levels))
  n <- sum(tab)
  observed <- sum(diag(tab)) / n
  expected <- sum(rowSums(tab) * colSums(tab)) / n^2
  (observed - expected) / (1 - expected)
}

n_agree <- sum(
  validation_predictions$KPMP_assigned_metabotype ==
    validation_predictions$independent_validation_metabotype
)
agreement_binom <- stats::binom.test(n_agree, nrow(validation_predictions))
validation_kappa <- cohen_kappa(
  validation_predictions$KPMP_assigned_metabotype,
  validation_predictions$independent_validation_metabotype
)

agreement_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("Exact label agreement", "Cohen's kappa"),
  estimate = c(validation_exact_agreement, validation_kappa),
  confidence_lower = c(agreement_binom$conf.int[1], NA_real_),
  confidence_upper = c(agreement_binom$conf.int[2], NA_real_)
)

readr::write_csv(
  agreement_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__validation_fixed_vs_independent_k2_counts.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  agreement_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__validation_cluster_agreement_summary.csv")
)

agreement_summary
```

## Association of fixed KPMP assignments with validation CKD status
```{r validation-ckd-evaluation}
validation_ckd_eval <- validation_predictions %>%
  filter(!is.na(ckd_status)) %>%
  mutate(
    clipped_probability = pmin(
      pmax(probability_KPMP_metabotype_1, 1e-8),
      1 - 1e-8
    ),
    metabotype_logit_score = qlogis(clipped_probability),
    standardized_score = as.numeric(scale(metabotype_logit_score))
  )

if (length(unique(validation_ckd_eval$ckd_status)) < 2) {
  stop("Both CKD and reference participants are required for external evaluation.")
}

validation_ckd_roc <- pROC::roc(
  response = validation_ckd_eval$ckd_status,
  predictor = validation_ckd_eval$probability_KPMP_metabotype_1,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)
validation_ckd_auc_ci <- as.numeric(
  pROC::ci.auc(validation_ckd_roc, method = "delong")
)

ckd_assignment_table <- validation_ckd_eval %>%
  count(KPMP_assigned_metabotype, ckd_status, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    KPMP_assigned_metabotype = 1:2,
    ckd_status = 0:1,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  )

ckd_assignment_fisher <- safe_fisher_test(
  table(
    factor(
      as.integer(validation_ckd_eval$KPMP_assigned_metabotype == 1L),
      levels = 0:1
    ),
    factor(validation_ckd_eval$ckd_status, levels = 0:1)
  )
)

ckd_score_model <- stats::glm(
  ckd_status ~ standardized_score,
  data = validation_ckd_eval,
  family = stats::binomial()
)
ckd_score_coef <- summary(ckd_score_model)$coefficients["standardized_score", ]
ckd_score_log_ci <- stats::confint.default(ckd_score_model)[
  "standardized_score",
  ]

ckd_association_summary <- tibble(
  analysis = c(
    "AUC: fixed KPMP metabotype probability versus CKD",
    "Logistic OR for CKD per 1-SD higher metabotype score",
    "Fisher OR: assigned Metabotype 1 versus CKD"
  ),
  estimate = c(
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(validation_ckd_roc)),
    exp(ckd_score_coef["Estimate"]),
    unname(ckd_assignment_fisher$estimate)
  ),
  confidence_lower = c(
    validation_ckd_auc_ci[1],
    exp(ckd_score_log_ci[1]),
    ckd_assignment_fisher$conf.int[1]
  ),
  confidence_upper = c(
    validation_ckd_auc_ci[3],
    exp(ckd_score_log_ci[2]),
    ckd_assignment_fisher$conf.int[2]
  ),
  p_value = c(
    NA_real_,
    ckd_score_coef["Pr(>|z|)"],
    ckd_assignment_fisher$p.value
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  ckd_assignment_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__validation_KPMP_assignment_by_CKD.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  ckd_association_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__validation_CKD_association_summary.csv")
)
```

## Metabolite-profile concordance


```{r profile-concordance}
kpmp_profile_contrast <- safe_profile_contrast(
  kpmp_X_classifier,
  kpmp_assignments$metabotype == 1L
)
validation_predicted_contrast <- safe_profile_contrast(
  validation_X_fixed,
  validation_predictions$KPMP_assigned_metabotype == 1L
)
validation_independent_contrast <- safe_profile_contrast(
  validation_X_fixed,
  validation_predictions$independent_validation_metabotype == 1L
)

profile_concordance <- tibble(
  metabolite = shared_metabolites,
  KPMP_metabotype_contrast = kpmp_profile_contrast,
  validation_fixed_assignment_contrast = validation_predicted_contrast,
  validation_independent_k2_contrast = validation_independent_contrast
) %>%
  left_join(kpmp$labels, by = "metabolite") %>%
  left_join(validation$labels, by = "metabolite") %>%
  mutate(
    display_label = coalesce(metabolite_label, validation_label, metabolite)
  )

profile_cor_fixed <- suppressWarnings(
  cor(
    profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
    profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )
)
profile_cor_independent <- suppressWarnings(
  cor(
    profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
    profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )
)

profile_summary <- tibble(
  comparison = c(
    "KPMP versus validation fixed-classifier assignments",
    "KPMP versus validation independent k = 2 assignments"
  ),
  spearman_rho = c(profile_cor_fixed, profile_cor_independent),
  n_metabolites = c(
    sum(complete.cases(
      profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
      profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast
    )),
    sum(complete.cases(
      profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
      profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast
    ))
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  profile_concordance,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__shared_metabolite_profile_concordance.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  profile_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table__metabolite_profile_concordance_summary.csv")
)
```

```{r figure-statistics}
# Share of each validation group assigned to Metabotype 1 (annotated on panel C).

  group_by(ckd_status) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    percent_metabotype_1 = 100 * mean(KPMP_assigned_metabotype == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Proportion of shared metabolites whose Metabotype 1 - 2 contrast has the same
# sign in KPMP and validation, overall and for metabolites with a clear KPMP effect.
sign_agree <- function(a, b, min_abs = 0) {
  keep <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b) & abs(a) > min_abs
  mean(sign(a[keep]) == sign(b[keep]))
}
large_contrast_cutoff <- 0.5

sign_agreement_summary <- tibble(
  comparison = rep(
    c("Fixed-classifier assignments", "Independent k = 2 assignments"),
    each = 2
  ),
  subset = rep(
    c("All shared metabolites",
      paste0("|KPMP contrast| > ", large_contrast_cutoff)),
    times = 2
  ),
  n_metabolites = c(
    sum(is.finite(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast) &
          is.finite(profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast)),
    sum(abs(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast) > large_contrast_cutoff &
          is.finite(profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast),
        na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(is.finite(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast) &
          is.finite(profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast)),
    sum(abs(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast) > large_contrast_cutoff &
          is.finite(profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast),
        na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  proportion_same_direction = c(
    sign_agree(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
               profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast),
    sign_agree(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
               profile_concordance$validation_fixed_assignment_contrast,
               large_contrast_cutoff),
    sign_agree(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
               profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast),
    sign_agree(profile_concordance$KPMP_metabotype_contrast,
               profile_concordance$validation_independent_k2_contrast,
               large_contrast_cutoff)
  )
)
```

```{r external-validation-figure, fig.width=16, fig.height=9.5}
    title = "Fixed KPMP score in validation",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "AUC for CKD %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\nDashed line: KPMP-derived threshold = %.3f",
      as.numeric(pROC::auc(validation_ckd_roc)),
      validation_ckd_auc_ci[1],
      validation_ckd_auc_ci[3],
      fixed_classifier$threshold
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probability of KPMP Metabotype 1"
  )

# D. Agreement between fixed assignments and independent validation clustering
p_cluster_agreement <- ggplot(
  agreement_table,
  aes(
    factor(independent_validation_metabotype),
    factor(KPMP_assigned_metabotype),
    fill = n
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#2166AC") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Agreement with independent validation k = 2",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Exact agreement = %.1f%%; Cohen's kappa = %.2f",
      100 * validation_exact_agreement,
      validation_kappa
    ),
    x = "Independent validation clustering",
    y = "Fixed KPMP classifier",
    fill = "n"
  )

# E and F (metabolite profiles) are built in the previous chunk.
p_external_validation <- (
  p_internal_roc | p_ckd_by_metabotype | p_validation_scores
) / (
  p_cluster_agreement | p_profile_fixed | p_profile_independent
) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

save_tiff(
  p_external_validation,
  "Figure_fixed_KPMP_classifier_external_validation.tiff",
  width = 16,
  height = 9.5
)
save_pdf(
  p_external_validation,
  "Figure__fixed_KPMP_classifier_external_validation.pdf",
  width = 16,
  height = 9.5
)

#p_external_validation
```
